perspectives.conclusion: Add one platform-owned exact dev namespace scope and require the existing unique fresh DeploymentGrant/Profile join to report environment dev. Do not add another entitlement database or repository-controlled security input.

PR #151 is merged and inert but unsafe to enable: matching repository ID plus namespace without an explicit dev boundary permits a production grant. CREATE and DELETE need a pre-authorization dev fence and prod-negative tests.

Access-controller must remain undeployed/plan-only until this external admission boundary is merged, released, and proven. The image-cap implementation is already merged; immutable publication and rollout remain later gates.

consensus: Implement the dev-only boundary in deployment-controller on current main and keep roleBindingAdmission disabled.
Keep namespace, repository identity, group subject, roleRef, and break-glass authority centrally controlled and fail closed for prod, unknown, stale, malformed, partial, or ambiguous state.
Preserve the merged five-binary image-size and supply-chain invariants; do not raise the publisher cap or duplicate PR #153.
Do not dispatch releases, publish artifacts, deploy, enable admission, or change access-controller apply mode in this pipeline.
Require exact-head CI and independent review before merge consideration; require separate fresh release and deployment evidence later.

live_constraints.admission: disabled and inert; no live exposure
live_constraints.release: no post-v0.13.0 immutable release; v0.14.0 must not be reused
